jobs_results.title: Senior QA Engineer - Spain - Remote Working
jobs_results.description:
CloudPay is an organisation of over 1,100 people united by a single purpose – to modernise the pay experience for business and people, raising the importance of pay processes beyond an operational function to become a true business advantage.

With a proud heritage of over 25 years, we are trusted to manage the pay processes of 250 global organisations, processing over 2.5 million payslips a year in 130 countries, handling over $24bn of payments in 168 currencies. We fully understand the challenges facing payroll teams and are committed to improving them.

Our integrated portfolio of payroll, funding, payments and pay on-demand solutions are delivered through a single cloud-based platform that can be deployed anywhere in the world. By unifying payroll, treasury and HCM functions and leveraging the latest technology, we can transform pay processes, making them fast and friction-free.

We’re making payroll more flexible, with services that can be deployed globally, regionally and... locally giving employees a choice of how they prefer to be paid – making pay a key differentiator.

The benefits of working at CloudPay include a competitive compensation package, career development opportunities, access to wellness resources, and a vibrant global culture.

We are looking for passionate individuals who maintain a strong desire to succeed.

Our fast-growing team is looking for a passionate and engaged QA Automation Engineer with strong automation skills to join our Agile engineering team building our leading cloud-based payroll platform.

“The QA Automation Engineer will work within agile teams, and globally, to ensure the quality of the platform continues to exceed customer expectations”

#LI-NUSH

Daily Duties and Main Responsibilities will include:
• Plan, design, implement and execute end to end automated tests for our API, web and mobile applications.
• Conduct reviews and inspections that pertain to test automation.
• Spearhead activities related to identification of the appropriate test automation approach, set up and maintain the automation infrastructure, and drive automation coverage of the different supported products.
• Analyze automation test results, report bugs, perform root cause analysis of bugs, and track bugs to closure.
• Design, create, and execute manual test cases for API testing, functional testing, integration testing, and regression testing (as necessary).
• Being part of a multi-disciplinary team and provide value all along the development cycle.
• Analyse and report QA activities regularly.
• Collaborate with team members to determine overall test strategy (through technical test design and Test Automation Support) and improve testing quality.
Attributes and Experience required:
• 6+ years experience in software testing with focus on test automation (at least 3 years of working experience as a QA automation engineer).
• In depth knowledge of good coding practices, demonstrable through code reviews and promotion of best practice/design of internal guidelines.
• Strong knowledge in building automation tests using Java/Kotlin.
• Experience working with open source test automation tools like Selenium/Cypress, Appium, Karate DSL , Postman, TestNG.
• Experience in designing Test Automation Framework (Data Driven or Keyword Driven Frameworks).
• Experience in building reusable components, keywords or listeners for test automation.
• Proficiency in test case definition, execution and validation.
• Knowledge of Version control systems like Bitbucket/SVN/Github and practices.
Nice to have:
• Experience with microservices
Behavioral Qualities
• Self-motivated and a good team player
• Excellent logical, analytical and root cause analysis skills
Package and Benefits:
• Competitive annual salary
• 24 days annual leave, plus bank holidays
• Earned Wage Access (via CloudPay Now app)
• Birthday leave
• Life assurance
• Private medical insurance
• Personal and professional development opportunities
#J-18808-Ljbffr

jobs_results.title: Senior Tester/Qa
jobs_results.description:
People are at the center of everything we do at TK Elevator – we work as one global team, watch out for each other's safety and share a common vision to keep the world moving.
This is your opportunity to help us shape the future of TKE and our customers – are you ready for the challenge to combine the digital world with our leading hardware solutions?

With integrated cloud-based solutions such as our MAX platform, we embrace the full potential of digitalization, transforming ourselves into a digitally augmented company to make life easier, more efficient and more comfortable.

TK Elevator aims to be a leader in industrial IoT solutions, data enabled solutions software solutions that make our customers and users successful and happy.
Jointly with leading technology companies as strategic partners, we have just released our first Digital Native Elevator EOX. We will continue this journey - to improve the lives of people everywhere, every day.
You will co-drive this journey with a... dynamic and growing team that uses leading technology and works in a truly global setup to solve challenging problems, develop new business solutions and digital products:

Hands on colleague performing manual execution of functional testing, regression testing, smoke testing, exploratory testing and UAT as well as automated tests with the Dev TeamsPerform software testing based on business timelines and sprint schedulesCreate test scripts, execute tests, and prepare and present reports and metrics to management and development partnersPartner with Development teams to help reproduce and diagnose issues and to continuously improve our testing approach and setupCollaboration with the Quality Management Team to manage the software release process and prepare technical documentationImmerse yourself into the TKE B2B world, understand our Hardware and Software solutions and take an end-to-end viewBe an advocate for our customers/users and make sure in a pragmatic/hands on way that the solutions workBe a team player, bringing development, business, process know how, design and other competencies togetherBachelor's degree or equivalent in Engineering, SW development or alikeOver 8 years of professional experience in software testing and quality assuranceProven expertise in unit tests, performance testing, load testing, system integration testing, and user acceptance testingExperience with continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) practices is a plusSolid knowledge of testing tools and frameworksProficiency in scripting and programming languages (e.g., Python, Java) for test automationExperience in working with DevTeams and Product Teams (PO, designer, devs) and with Microsoft Azure technologyExcellent problem-solving skills and attention to detailTarget-group appropriate communication and collaboration skills & team playerProficient English communication skills, both written and spokenSecure job and salary – permanent contract in a technically exciting, stable, and sustainable industry and an attractive compensation packageSocial benefits and an attractive work calendar.
Teamwork & safety – an open, transparent, and value-oriented cultureIndividualized training plan from your very first day.
TK Elevator is a company with an open, transparent culture that focuses on the people who make it up. At TKE you will receive frequent feedback, continuous training and space to contribute your ideas.
#J-18808-Ljbffr

jobs_results.title: Senior Quality Assurance Engineer (Multi Category Retail)
jobs_results.description:
Job Summary

Centric Software provides enterprise software applications in the fast-moving consumer goods market to manage, optimize, and execute business processes. Our software solutions help our customers in taking their products from conception to production, and in between managing their material, sourcing, quality, and pricing on their way to producing their final catalog.

We are constantly innovating, both in terms of the functionality that we off our users and in the technology that we use for our applications. We are adding a Senior Quality Assurance Engineer to our team to provide product quality testing and solutions around our Enterprise and Saas software offerings.

Responsibilities
• Creating and executing test plans, test cases, and test scenarios to verify software functionality, performance, and stability for our Enterprise applications specific to PLM or multi-category retail domains.
• Developing and maintaining automated test scripts using various automation tools... and programming languages
• Collaborating with the development team to ensure that the software meets the requirements and quality standards.
• Perform root cause analysis and implementation of corrective actions for product and process related activities
• Improving and maintaining the automated testing framework to ensure its efficiency, scalability, and reliability
• Write automation scripts in Selenium, Java, Python, or Unix Shell. Experience in enhancing test automation frameworks like Cucumber, TestNG, Appium, and Playwright.
• Collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure that the software meets compliance, security, and accessibility requirements.
• Mentoring and coaching team members at different regions on best practices, automation techniques, and industry trends
• Lead performance testing efforts to assess system scalability and stability under retail-specific scenarios.

Qualifications
• 8+ years of experience in Software Quality Testing and worked in Agile development model
• Bachelor’s degree in computer science or information technology or a related field.
• Excellent analytical skills, problem-solving abilities, and attention to detail.
• Proven experience as a QA tester in the PLM domain, multi-category retail domain, or similar retail-specific projects.
• Profound knowledge of retail processes, and inventory management.
• Familiarity with bug tracking systems and test management tools.
• Knowledge of CI/CD tools like Jenkins for pipeline projects.
• Excellent communication and teamwork skills.
• Self-learner and passionate about technology.
• Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to think critically.
• Adaptability and the ability to work in a fast-paced and constantly evolving retail environment.

What We Offer
• Competitive salary and benefits
• A multifaceted job with a high degree of responsibility and a broad spectrum of opportunities
• Opportunity to work remotely with a dedicated and motivated team
• A remote work environment built on collaboration, flexibility, and respect
• Varied and challenging work to help you grow your technical skillset

Centric Software provides equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to race, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, color, age, religion, protected veteran or disability status or genetic information

jobs_results.title: Salesforce Manual Functional QA - 100% Remote
jobs_results.description:
Role Description

UST is looking for the very Top Talent…and we would be delighted if you were to join our family!

More in details, UST is a multinational company based in North America, certified as a Top Employer company with over 35.000 employees all over the world and presence in more than 35 countries. We are leaders on digital technology services, and we provide large-scale technologic solutions to big companies.

What are we looking for?

For our team specialised we are looking for a Salesforce Manual QA to be part of a team working close to one of our main clients.

This position can be performed 100% remote from any location in Spain.

Main Tasks And Accountabilities Will Be
• Tester will be part of a Squad working to an Agile Methodology.
• Attend and Contribute to daily stand ups, tsprint review meetings and retro's.
• Provide Test Effort/Estimates against user stories.
• Tester to work under own initiative to conduct user story analysis, script writing, test data... preparation, test execution and raising/monitoring incidents.
• To create and sustain effective relationships with all customers / stakeholders to identify mutual benefits and share best practice for the support in the delivery of the deployments to live.

What UST expects from you?
• 4+ years (at least 2 in Salesforce Manual testers)
• Proficient in Conflunce, JIRA and JIRA Xray
• Experience of working in a fast paced Agile enviroment
• Excellent oral and written communication skills in English.
• Excellent attention to detail, analytical and troubleshooting skills.
• ISTQB Certified

What can we offer?
• 23 days of Annual Leave plus the 24th and 31st of December as discretionary days!
• Numerous benefits (Health Care Plan, teleworking compensation, Life and Accident Insurances).
• `Retribución Flexible´ Program: (Meals, Kinder Garden, Transport, online English lessons, Heath Care Plan…)
• Free access to several training platforms
• Professional stability and career plans
• UST also, compensates referrals from which you could benefit when you refer professionals.
• The option to pick between 12 or 14 payments along the year.
• Real Work Life Balance measures (flexibility, WFH or remote work policy, compacted hours during summertime…)
• UST Club Platform discounts and gym Access discounts
• Work from home

If you would like to know more, do not hesitate to apply and we’ll get in touch to fill you in details. UST is waiting for you!

In UST we are committed to equal opportunities in our selection processes and do not discriminate based on race, gender, disability, age, religion, sexual orientation or nationality.

Skills
• Salesforce,Confluence,Jira
• QA Manual
• 100% Remote
• English B2+/C1

jobs_results.title: QA Automation Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Nuvolar is looking for a QA Automation Engineer to join us!

With over 14+ years of experience and 12+ as an official Salesforce partner, Nuvolar Works specializes in cloud-based solutions, utilizing different technologies across various industries, including private aviation and food and beverage, on a global scale.

But let's dive into the truly intriguing aspect. What sets Nuvolar apart is our incredibly diverse, outgoing team, dynamic workplace, and numerous employee benefits.

Why us?

At Nuvolar, we are a team of around 90 talented people devoted to developing amazing software solutions. Our people are our greatest asset and one of the key reasons Nuvolar has been certified as a GREAT PLACE TO WORK. Want to hear what our employees have to say about working here? Check out how we achieved the Great Place to Work certification

At Nuvolar, we develop amazing applications. Our aim is not only to create functional software but to build cool, game-changing applications that transform... industries. And we are proud to do so!

Our values

Our company values drive everything we do. These values define who we are:
• We are honest and we have integrity
• We take ownership and deliver excellence
• We are driven by change and new challenges
• We are learners
• We have fun and enjoy the NuvoFamily adventure together

Do you share these values? If so, keep reading! 👇

How will you contribute to Nuvolar's QA team?

Your mission as a QA Automation engineer will be to help define any part of a project testing strategy such as the types of testing required, the technology stack, the infrastructure needed, CI setup, and QA process.

You will pursue our mission by performing the following contributions:
• Participate in both Manual and Automation tasks.
• Will be in charge of the assigned automation tasks (understand the requirements of the story, write an appropriate set of test cases, code the necessary automation tests)
• Find gaps/issues in the code/design of the testing framework.
• Help defining any part of a project testing strategy.
• Participate in code reviews for other team members.
• Designing and performing functional testing of the applications.
• Designing and performing API testing using 3rd party tools (e.g., postman).
• Write high-level documentation in a clear and structured way: class diagrams, test-framework/test suite flow, etc..
• Help coordinating the release process and maintain created Continuous Integration pipeline.
• Assist junior team members when requested.
• Designing and implementing automatic BackEnd /REST API tests in Java (using Requests library or similar)"

Now, what will make you succeed with us?
• 3+ years of experience working with Manual and Automation testing
• Medium coding skills in Java.
• Basic understanding of Docker
• Deep knowledge of testing design patterns and automation patterns.
• GIT methodology.
• Basic knowledge of relational Databases and SQL
• Successfully use ISTQB test design best practices.
• Extensive CI/CD knowledge
• Gherkin syntax knowledge is desired
• Familiarity with Agile Software Development Methodologies.
• Strong oral and written communication skills in English.

What will we bring to you?
• Flexible remote work policy (you can decide if you'd like to work 100% remotely or come to our offices in Barcelona)
• Flexible working hours, work-life balance always comes first
• Summer schedule every day of July and August.
• Enjoy every other Friday as a day off!
• Career path with continuous training - we have a library and all of the learning tools you need to study something cool
• Social events and activities/Funday Fridays/Lunch&Learns
• Day off on your birthday!
• Private Health Insurance
• Gym allowance
• Phantom shares options
• Free languages classes
• International environment. Respect, diversity & a lot of fun.
• Great Referral program.

Our recruitment process

1st step: Cultural fit interview

During this face-to-face interview, we want to meet the candidate and understand the expectations regarding career plan and motivation and give the candidate an overview of the role and Nuvolar's work environment. Also laying out everything we can offer you and what you can bring to our Nuvofamily so that we can succeed together!

2nd step: Technical test

If the cultural fit interview goes well, we will invite you to move forward and solve a technical challenge based on your role and experience and assessed by our technical team.

3rd step: Technical Interview with the team

After passing the technical test, it's time for a technical discussion around the exercise to better understand your skills and an introduction to the Tech Lead and other team members to give you a better idea of Nuvolar's team culture and so you can meet some potential future colleagues.

Want to learn more about life at Nuvolar? Take a look at our social channels:

LinkedIn | Instagram | Glassdoor | Medium—-

If your profile fits the position, and you are excited about becoming a Nuvolad or Nuvolady, we would love to hear from you!

Nuvolar Works is an equal opportunity employer and will not discriminate against any applicant on the basis of age, gender, sexual orientation, disability, national origin, race, or religion

jobs_results.title: QA Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Carnect is a leading car rental distribution specialist working worldwide with a portfolio of over 150 car rental suppliers. Through Carnect's class-leading technology and intelligent solutions, our clients (OTAs, Bedbanks, Tour Operators, Travel Agencies and membership organisations) are able to access a massive range of car rental content, adapted to their individual requirements.

Carnect was founded in Hamburg in 1999 as MicronNexus GmbH and is part of Hotelbeds Group. We are a leader in delivering tailored and fully managed solutions to grow your car rental profits. Our focus is simple: providing your customers with the right car, in the right place, at the right price.

We are seeking a skilled QA Engineer to join our dynamic team. As a QA Engineer, you will be responsible for ensuring the quality and reliability of our software products through the creation and execution of comprehensive test plans and the development of automated test scripts. The ideal candidate will have a... strong background in software testing methodologies, experience in creating detailed test plans, and proficiency in test automation tools and frameworks.

Key Responsibilities
• Develop and execute detailed, comprehensive test plans to ensure the quality and stability of software products.
• Collaborate closely with software developers, product managers, and other stakeholders to understand project requirements and identify test scenarios.
• Design and implement automated test scripts using industry-standard test automation tools and frameworks.
• Conduct regression testing to verify that new features and enhancements do not adversely impact existing functionality.
• Perform exploratory testing to uncover defects and areas for improvement in the software.
• Analyze test results and communicate findings to relevant stakeholders, including identifying trends and patterns in defects.
• Participate in the software development lifecycle, providing input on design, usability, and quality considerations.
• Continuously improve testing processes and methodologies to enhance efficiency and effectiveness.
• Stay current with industry trends and best practices in software quality assurance and test automation.

Qualifications
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
• Proven experience as a QA Engineer or similar role, with a minimum of 2 years of experience in software testing.
• Strong understanding of software testing principles, methodologies, and best practices.
• Experience creating detailed test plans and test cases for complex software systems.
• Proficiency in test automation tools such as Selenium, Appium, or similar.
• Hands-on experience with programming languages such as JavaScript or C# or similar.
• Familiarity with version control systems such as Git.
• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with a keen attention to detail.
• Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
• Proven ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience working in an Agile development environment.
• Knowledge of continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines.
• Certification in software testing (e.g., ISTQB, CSTE) is a plus.
• Experience with performance testing tools and techniques.
• Familiarity with cloud computing platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud

jobs_results.title: QA Automation JAVA - España
jobs_results.description:
¿Te interesaría seguir desarrollándote como QA Automation en un equipo multicultural con presencia internacional?

Desde Oxigent Technologies seleccionamos un/a QA AUTOMATION para participar en la definición de las estrategias de testing del equipo de nuestro cliente Ubicado en Barcelona.

¿Cuáles serán tus funciones principales?
• Participará en tareas tanto manuales como de automatización.
• Se encargará de las tareas de automatización asignadas (comprender los requisitos de la historia, escribir un conjunto adecuado de casos de prueba, codificar las pruebas de automatización necesarias).
• Encontrar lagunas/problemas en el código/diseño del marco de pruebas.
• Ayudar a definir cualquier parte de la estrategia de pruebas de un proyecto.
• Participar en revisiones de código para otros miembros del equipo.
• Diseñar y realizar pruebas funcionales de las aplicaciones.
• Diseñar y realizar pruebas de API utilizando herramientas de terceros.
• Redactar documentación de alto nivel de... forma clara y estructurada: diagramas de clases, test-framework/test suite flow, etc..
• Ayudar a coordinar el proceso de lanzamiento y mantener el pipeline de Integración Continua creado.
• Ayudar a los miembros del equipo junior cuando se solicite.
• Diseñar e implementar pruebas automáticas BackEnd /REST API en Java (usando la librería Requests o similar)"

ello, ¿qué vas a necesitar?
• 3 Años de experiencia trabajando con testing manual y automatizado.
• Conocimientos de código en Java
• Conocimientos de Docker
• Conocmientos de BBDD SQL
• Conocimeintos avanzados de CI/CD
• Otros conocimientos técnicos requeridos o deseados: Postman, Swagger, Metodología GIT, Gherkin.
• Trabajaras con Clientes de USA, por lo que el nivel de inglés es Avanzado (C1).

¿Qué te ofrecemos?
• Contratación indefinida a través de Oxigent.
• Salario acorde a la experiencia aportada (38.000 – 41.000 euros brutos anuales).
• Horario flexible.
• Modelo de trabajo 100% en remoto.
• Cheque Formación para desarrollarte en las áreas profesionales que más te interesen.
• Seguro médico privado.
• Retribución flexible aplicable a seguro médico, restaurante, transporte, guardería y formación.
• Aplicación de acceso a gimnasios y actividades deportivas en toda España con descuentos.

¡Y muchos otros beneficios

jobs_results.title: Senior QA Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Job Title

Senior QA Engineer

Summary

We are seeking a Senior QA Engineer to join our team, contributing to the quality assurance of our products and services. In this role, you will leverage your advanced technical knowledge to influence decisions, define test strategies, design test cases, execute tests, manage defects, and report on test activities. You will also play a key role in mentoring team members, sharing knowledge, and promoting quality assurance best practices.

In This Role You Will
• Attend specification/architecture reviews and provide feedback, ensuring alignment with quality guidelines and industry best practices.
• Define test strategies and plans, ensuring traceability with specifications and customer requirements.
• Design test cases, prepare test environments, and execute test cases, providing sign-off on tested features.
• Assess the necessity for test automation and contribute to the improvement of test automation frameworks.
• Open defects, assign severity... levels, verify fixes, and provide visibility on test activities to stakeholders.
• Efficiently use QA tooling stack and frameworks, proposing improvements and staying proactive about issues and changes.
• Drive proposals for continuous improvement in quality processes and participate in implementing new tools and technologies.
• Contribute to understanding, measuring, and reducing the environmental impact of tested applications and QA activities.

About The Ideal Candidate
• Experience in software functional testing (manual and automated), based on ISTQB principles.
• Experience in Backend and API testing,
• Experience in testing tools such as RobotFramework. Postman is a plus
• Knowledge of coding language and building testing libraries (Python or another language)
• Experience in an Agile environment Scrum. SAFe is a plus.
• Basic knowledge about the implementation of QA regression in a CI/CD pipeline (Jenkins, Docker usage) is a plus. UI Test automation is a plus.

If you're ready to make an impact and drive quality excellence in a dynamic environment, apply now to join our team as a Senior QA Engineer.

What We Can Offer You
• Add your voice to a multicultural team of 16,000+ professionals.
• Work at one of the world’s top 15 software companies.
• Challenge yourself to find solutions to complex problems.
• Flexible hybrid work from 1-2 days per week.
• Competitive compensation and benefits package.

Application process

Create your candidate profile in our system and upload your recent resume! Once you have applied, you’ll receive feedback within 15 days.

Are you ready to leave your footprint? Be the power behind better journeys.

Diversity & Inclusion

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and seek to hire the best candidate regardless of age, beliefs, disability, ethnicity, gender or sexual orientation

jobs_results.title: Work From Home QA Tech Lead (WKL)
jobs_results.description:
Overview of the Role:

We are looking to hire a skilled QA Tech Lead capable of delivering high standards of technical quality and innovation, always striving for continuous improvement, and looking to help all different types of clients around the world.

To ensure success, you must have detailed knowledge of development techniques, excellent communication, and organizational skills.

As part of the team, you will:
• Ensure software quality across development stages.
• Collaborate with Product Owners for user story refinement and acceptance criteria definition.
• Translate high-level acceptance criteria into specific scenarios and test sets.
• Create and oversee comprehensive test plans, including load testing.
• Drive QA initiative, fostering shared responsibility for technical quality.
• Monitor software quality throughout its lifecycle.

Key qualifications and skills to succeed in this role:
• Intermediate English
• Fluent Spanish level
• 5+ years as QA Lead in projects
•... Experience in Java, Cucumber, and Karate
• Strong experience in testing strategy definition
• Successful history of implementing automated regression tests
• Knowledge of Agile ceremonies and QA's role

In return, we offer:
• Competitive compensation package
• 100% remote work
• International company with diversity and multicultural inclusion
• The ability to work with leading startups and fast-growing companies

jobs_results.description:
NTT Data somos todas las personas que la formamos. Un equipo de más de 139.000 profesionales, tan diverso cómo diversos son los 50 países en los que estamos presentes y los diferentes sectores en los que desarrollamos nuestra actividad.

Nuestra esencia nos ha llevado a la vanguardia de la tecnología, a romper paradigmas y a brindar las soluciones que realmente se corresponden a las necesidades de cada cliente. Nuestro talento nos ha hecho poder decir con orgullo que somos una de las 6 empresas TOP de tecnologías en el mundo.

El equipo de especialistas de calidad de NTT DATA está creciendo cada día más, gracias a la colaboración con el gran número de clientes que confían en nosotros y sus variados proyectos. Por ello, queremos que tú tengas la oportunidad de unirte a nuestro equipo, ¿quieres formar parte de este reto?

En nuestra oficina de Madrid buscamos responsables de proyecto en el área de calidad capaces de liderar servicios de Quality Services en grandes clientes. Se requieren... profesionales con al menos 6 años de experiencia en diferentes proyectos de testing, capaces de liderar equipos multidisciplinares, realizar asesorías de calidad a cliente y reportar a capa de ejecutiva.

¿Cuáles serán tus responsabilidades?
• Identificar las necesidades en cuento a calidad/pruebas se refiere en un cliente.
• Proponer soluciones de testing o metodológicas en base a su experiencia.
• Definir estrategias de pruebas.
• Interpretar políticas de prueba establecidas por cliente.
• Tener un conocimiento básico sobre automatización de pruebas y pruebas de rendimiento.
• Liderar de un equipo de testing y gestión de personas.
• Gestionar las necesidades del cliente.
• Reportar a capa de ejecutiva unidad de testing.

¿Qué podemos ofrecerte?
• Un plan de formación adaptado a tu experiencia profesional y a tu medida, dándote la oportunidad de formarte y certificarte en diferentes áreas de conocimiento.
• Trabajar en proyectos nacionales e internacionales con empresas de gran prestigio
• Plan de carrera personalizado acorde a tus motivaciones e inquietudes profesionales que te permita desarrollar tu talento.
• Flexibilidad horaria.
• Beneficios sociales

¡NTT DATA es tu sitio! Porque hemos obtenido en España, por 9º año consecutivo, la certificación Top Employer, que nos reconoce como una de las mejores empresas en las que trabajar, gracias a nuestro compromiso por el talento. Únete a un equipo que apuesta por el desarrollo integral de sus profesionales, elige el modelo de trabajo que mejor se adapte a ti, y colabora en un entorno diverso, donde cada persona tiene su propia singularidad
